chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi navigates a tense meeting with Elder Master Shen at the Shen family mansion, where he learns about the upcoming ancestral rites. He meets with Lu Qian, a young woman from a family previously wronged by the Shen family, and they form a strategic alliance to take down the Shen family, exchanging sensitive information. Shen Feizhi returns home to find Gu Suizhou acting strangely aggressive and possessive, leading to a tense domestic interaction.

new_characters.name: Elder Master Shen
new_characters.description: The patriarch of the Shen family who is manipulating Shen Feizhi and keeping him from the family register.

new_characters.name: Shen Wei
new_characters.description: A member of the Shen family who is favored by Elder Master Shen and is a target of Shen Feizhi's revenge.

new_characters.name: Lu Qian
new_characters.description: A young woman from the Lu family who is working with Shen Feizhi to bring down the Shen family due to a past financial grudge.

new_locations.description: The location of the Shen family's ancestral cemetery.
